shots.title: EXP-45: a tower of three storeys and a roof on the blank map (the squad starts at the lower left)

marks.text: the way in: a doorway in the west wall of the ground storey
the roof deck (floor 4): a soldier should be able to stand here, reached by the ladder from storey 3
the roof's open end, over the third storey's ladder

shots.title: EXP-45: the ground storey (the editor's Floors at 1: everything above hidden, the walls cut down)

marks.text: ladder 1, inside at the north end: from the ground up to the second storey's deck
the second storey's deck: the four rows at the south end. A soldier should walk on all of it
ladder 1 arrives here: the two open rows at the north end are the way up
ladder 2: from this deck up to the third storey's, which starts over the next row north
the third storey's deck: the four rows at the north end. The two rows at the south end are open, over ladder 2
ladder 3: from this deck up to the roof deck
